title: Foundry Actions Framework for Audit-Trail Discipline — Risk-Rating Changes, Regulatory Documentation, and the Examiner-Ready Audit Log
validation_scope: ElevateRiskRating ActionType YAML matches seed specification: target_object, authorization_level, required_inputs with constraint expressions, side_effects, post_execution hooks.
AuditEntry JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) covers every field the article walks; immutable=true is constant constraint.
10 examiner-ready query templates including the action-vs-bypass reconciliation query (catches the bypass-control gap continuously).
6 bypass paths enumerated with recommended controls and quarterly self-assessment requirement.
Retention + approvals matrix with 7-year regulatory floors (FFIEC BSA/AML, SOX §404, SR 11-7 §V, FinCEN, OFAC) and segregation-of-duties enforcement rules.

Regulatory mapping covers 6 regulations (SR 11-7, OCC 2011-12, SOX §404, FFIEC BSA/AML, FinCEN 31 CFR §1010.230, PCAOB AS 2201) with separation of Foundry contribution from institution responsibility.
Worked example AuditEntry validates against schema; cross-references Article 004's AIP summary output via supporting_evidence_ids (demonstrates 004 → 005 handoff).
known_limits: Portable companion bundle; no live Foundry runtime executes the ActionType.
Institution's overall control environment, bypass-control implementation, ongoing-monitoring cadence, analyst training, control testing, and SAR-filing workflow integration are out-of-scope.
RBAC role names are generic (senior_analyst, compliance_manager); institution-specific mapping lives in deployment config.
Regulatory citations accurate as of 2026-05-15; regulators update guidance.
Justification text quality (not just 200-char length) is institution-side training discipline, not a platform-enforceable constraint.
framing_discipline: Foundry Actions framework provides the PRIMITIVES the institution uses to build an audit-trail discipline consistent with regulatory expectations. It does NOT by itself satisfy any specific regulator's requirements. The bypass-control discipline (bypass_controls/) and the institution's overall control environment determine examiner readiness.
